title: Honey Almond Cookie Matcha Latte
description:
​@emmachamberlain's take on a Honey Almond Cookie Matcha Latte using our new Honey Matcha.

Ingredients:
1-2 tsp. Honey Matcha
1 tsp. honey
½ tsp. almond extract
1 c. milk of choice
1-2 tsp. Nutpods Vanilla Creamer

Directions: Whisk the Honey Matcha until smooth and frothy, then add the honey and almond extract and blend until fully combined. Pour the matcha into your milk of choice and finish by topping it with Nutpods Vanilla Creamer.

title: Drink in America | Coca-Cola’s America250 Anthem Film
description:
Celebrate 250 years of America with Coca-Cola’s “Drink in America” anthem film — a tribute to the people, places, and moments that bring us together.

Created for the America250 campaign, this film explores the enduring connection between Coca-Cola and the American story. From coast to coast, across cities and small towns, we celebrate a nation built on shared experiences, culture, and community.

Featuring a reimagined version of “I’d Like to Buy the World a Coke,” thoughtfully rewritten for this moment in history, this campaign reflects the spirit of unity, optimism, and belonging that defines America today.

So, here’s to the healers, fighters, cowboys, and city slickers. The mothers, fathers, sons, and daughters. The storytellers and the dreamers. There’s room for everyone to belong here. Because within these people, places, and moments, there’s an America that promises, believes, and loves.

That’s the real thing.

title: THE Original Rice Krispies Cereal Treats Recipe
description:
Looking for the best homemade Rice Krispies Treats recipe? You’ve found it! Nothing beats the ooey gooey goodness of a homemade Kellogg’s Rice Krispies treat! 
This video shows you how to make the classic Original Rice Krispies Treats using just 3 simple ingredients: marshmallows, butter, and Kellogg’s® Rice Krispies® cereal.

✅ Quick & Easy
✅ No-Bake Dessert
✅ Perfect for Kids, Parties & Holidays

📋 Ingredients:
• ¼ cup butter or margarine
• 5 cups miniature or 40 regular marshmallows
• 6 cups Kellogg’s® Rice Krispies® cereal

👨‍🍳 Instructions:
1. Melt butter in a large saucepan over low heat.
2. Add marshmallows and stir until completely melted.
3. Remove from heat and mix in Kellogg’s® Rice Krispies® cereal. Stir until well coated.
4. Using buttered spatula, press into a greased 13” x 9” pan. Let cool.
5. Cut, serve, and enjoy!

✨ Whether you're making these for a bake sale, a family gathering, or just a nostalgic snack, this original Rice Krispies Treats recipe is a guaranteed crowd-pleaser.

title: Knorr | Back to School | Spinach Noodles
description:
Turn lunchbox into a nutritious treat with Knorr! Try Power-packed Spinach noodles recipe, perfect for a lunchtime meal.

Ingredients: 
Knorr Chicken Noodles 1 Pack
Minced Chicken  25 g
Spinach (Blanched and Chopped) 20 g
Garlic (Chopped) 5 g
Onion (Chopped) 10 g
Oil 10 g (2 tsp)
Cream 10 g (2 tsp)
Milk 30 ml 
Oregano 0.2 g
White Pepper 0.2 g

Directions: 
1. Boil the noodles in 400 ml water without tastemaker, once boiled drain the water and keep noodles aside.
2. Heat the oil in a wok/pan.
3. Stir-fry garlic and onion for a few seconds. Add minced chicken and cook until done. 
4. Add spinach and cook for another minute. 
5. Then add cream and milk and stir well to combine. Season now with Chicken Noodle Tastemaker. 
6. You can add white pepper as per your taste.
7. Add the noodles, and stir-fry well. Top-up with ground oregano.

Your delicious lunch box with Power-packed Spinach Noodles is ready!
